title: Cloudflare Workers AI and Vectorize in LangChain (Python)
summary: Collier King introduces his Python LangChain integration for Cloudflare's Vectorize vector database.
learn: Vectorize is Cloudflare's vector database on the edge; it stores vectors, metadata and namespaces, while D1 stores the raw data.
Install from a standalone package or LangChain community, with either a global API token or tokens for Vectorize and D1.
Indexes default to cosine similarity and 1024 dimensions; metadata filtering needs a metadata index.
Query with a top K, filter on metadata, search by ID, upsert new or changed data, and use the async functions.
Limits he lists: up to 1536 dimensions, 50,000 vectors and 50,000 namespaces per index; a TypeScript package already exists on npm.
